defect: related_finding_ids is added to the Finding zod schema with `.optional()`, mirrored identically in both server and client copies (mirror drift is not the issue here). The house fact (.claude/rules/shared-contracts.md) is that Review/Finding double as the LLM's strict structured-output schema (response_format json_schema, strict: true) — under strict mode `.optional()` silently becomes a required property (only a console warning, not an error), so the field must be `.nullish()`/`.nullable()` instead. General knowledge (plain zod/TypeScript, no LLM structured-output context) says `.optional()` is exactly correct for an additive, opt-in field.
